name: Overall Performance
query: SELECT r.participants.participant AS id, COUNT(*) AS games_played, SUM(CASE WHEN game->>'winner' = 'werewolves' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Wins, SUM(CASE WHEN game->>'winner' = 'villagers' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Losses FROM read_json_auto('results/*.json') AS r, UNNEST(r.results) AS t(game) GROUP BY id ORDER BY Wins DESC
